title: Respawn by Anchor
description: Plays the Return by Death sound effect from RE:ZERO when you die!
body:
**Respawn by Anchor** brings a small piece of **RE:ZERO** into Minecraft. Whenever you die, the iconic **Return by Death** sound effect plays, giving every death a dramatic and unsettling atmosphere.

Whether you're exploring dangerous caves, fighting powerful bosses, or losing your hardcore world for the hundredth time, this mod adds a familiar audio cue inspired by Subaru's ability from **RE:ZERO**.

Features
Plays the **Return by Death** sound effect upon death.
Lightweight and simple.
Works automatically with no configuration required.
Perfect for **RE:ZERO** fans and roleplay/modpack creators.

"_No matter how many times I die, I'll keep moving forward._"
